jetbrains.projectactions.keep-a-copy-mov: "Keep a copy" moves the folder to .smith/removed/ so you can get it back. "Delete" removes the folder for good, files that git cannot bring back included. Nothing is removed until you answer.
jetbrains.projectactions.remove-it-and-k: Remove it and keep a copy
jetbrains.projectactions.remove-it-and-d: Remove it and delete the folder
jetbrains.projectactions.monosmith-chang: MonoSmith: change the kind of a project
jetbrains.projectactions.make-it-an-app-: make it an app, a library or a package
jetbrains.projectactions.is-now-what-sho: {name} is {projectActionArgumentsAlgorithm} now. What should it become?
jetbrains.projectactions.nothing-was-cha: Nothing was changed yet. smith moves the folder and rewrites every place that names it.
jetbrains.projectactions.depends-on-no-l: {name} depends on no library of this workspace.
jetbrains.projectactions.which-library-s: Which library should the project stop using?
jetbrains.projectactions.stops-depending: {name} stops depending on {library}. The library stays in this workspace, and other projects keep using it. smith edits the manifest of {name} and runs the install.
